inclusion_rule: Studies that identify or verify the speaker (or subject) from a non-acoustic speech signal: lip or face motion video during speech, ultrasound, EMA, EMG, non-audible murmur or throat contact microphones, or EEG during speech tasks. Boundary: static face recognition without speech, acoustic-only speaker recognition, and identification used only as an auxiliary loss or nuisance factor are excluded; audio-visual fusion counts when the non-acoustic stream is scored on its own; versions count once.
